claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows the horizontal seam dividing the side plates, which is the distinct design feature of the Slim model.
General photos cannot confirm the absence of internal dust, overheating issues, or fine scratches.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or the HDMI port may be damaged.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting up to the PlayStation home screen.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized by the system, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: as a digital-only console with a broken drive

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the UI or a gameplay clip.

risks.risk: The console might be hardware-banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and displaying the dashboard on a TV.
Video demonstrating the disc drive functionality with a physical game.
Photo of the rear ports to ensure they are not bent or damaged.
Video of the controller being used to confirm no stick drift.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the identity of the item as a PS5 Slim with a disc drive and controller. It can be priced based on its worst-case functional state until further proof is provided.
